# Term

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A word or phrase used as the preferred or alternate label for a concept in a controlled vocabulary.

## Scope note

Refers to the lexical/label layer (skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel), not the concept itself - use for discussing naming/labeling conventions distinct from the concepts terms denote.
